prediction_text: Prediction: Barack Obama wins the 2008 US presidential election. The setting itself supplies the astrological signature the panel tradition reads: Saturn coming into opposition with Uranus beginning on Election Day — the first such configuration in 45 years — is the classic signature of upheaval and the defeat of the established order, which favours the insurgent change candidate (Obama) over the establishment figure (McCain, the presumptive Republican nominee of the incumbent party). Obama also holds the momentum in May 2008, leading the Democratic nomination race. Timing at day scale: the result is decided on Election Day, 4 November 2008, as the Saturn-Uranus opposition perfects.
